tools.name: getInfo
tools.description: Returns the complete profile of Jorge Arraga, an Argentinian AI-focused software engineer who is actively available for freelance projects. Includes his full work history, current role at Staffy, technical skills, ongoing English study, location, contact details, and links in English, Spanish, or Portuguese.

locale.description: Language for the returned information: en for English, es for Spanish, or pt for Brazilian Portuguese.
